title: DANGEROUS MORNING PRAYER BEFORE YOU START YOUR DAY
text: Something is shifting in the atmosphere right now. I need you to lift your hands wherever you are. Just lift your hands. Don't wait. Don't adjust yourself. Lift your hands because there is a wind that is beginning to move and if you miss this moment, you may not catch it again today. Father, we acknowledge you. We acknowledge that you are God. We acknowledge that before the sun rose this morning, before the alarm clock sounded, before the birds began to sing, you were already awake. You neither slumber nor sleep. And it was you who preserved us through the night. It was you who fought battles we didn't even know were happening. It was you who stationed angels at every entrance and exit of our lives while we slept and we are grateful. We are deeply, profoundly grateful. Now, I want you to pray with me. Don't be a spectator this morning. This is not a performance. This is a battle. And every man and woman who is alive today has already survived the night, but the day ahead is a new territory. And territory must be claimed. Territory must be consecrated. Territory must be covered by the blood of Jesus before you step into it. In Psalm 5:3, David said, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." David understood something that many believers have forgotten. The morning is a prophetic window. The morning is a gate. What you do at the opening of a gate determines what enters through that gate. If you open the morning with worship, worship will follow you. If you open the morning with fear, fear will trail you. If you open the morning with prayer and with the word of God, then the covenant of God will escort you through every second of that day. Receive this teaching in your spirit. This is not just devotional philosophy. This is kingdom intelligence. Satan knows the power of the morning. That is why sends assignments specifically designed to distract you in the early hours. He sends heaviness, he sends anxiety, he sends the noise of news, he sends voices that tell you to check your phone before you check in with God. These are not accidents. These are deliberate spiritual ambushes designed to steal your morning and by extension steal your day and by extension steal your momentum and by extension steal your season. But not today, not in this service, not for anyone connected to this altar. Let me show you something. In Mark chapter 1 verses 35, the Bible says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." This is Jesus, the Son of God, the one by whom all things were made, the one who had cast out demons the night before, the one who had healed Peter's mother-in-law, the one who had ministered until the whole city gathered at his door. And yet, after all of that, he woke up early, he went to a solitary place, and he prayed. If Jesus, the eternal Son of God, felt the absolute necessity of a dangerous morning prayer, what does that say about you and I? I said, "What does that say about you and I?" This means morning prayer is not a religious tradition for weak people who don't know how to cope with life. Morning prayer is the intelligence of heaven operating through submitted vessels on earth. Morning prayer is how sons and daughters of God synchronize their frequency with the frequency of the Father before they engage the noise of this world. Are you hearing me? In Isaiah 50 verses 4, the Lord God says, "He awakeneth morning by morning, he awakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned." Every morning God is speaking. Every morning heaven is downloading. Every morning angels are being dispatched with specific assignments. And the question is not whether God is active. The question is whether you are awake enough to receive. Whether you are postured correctly to hear. Whether your spirit is open or whether it is barricaded by sleep, by distraction, by the noise of yesterday's unresolved matters. Dangerous morning prayer is not just crying out to God. Dangerous morning prayer is establishing jurisdiction. It is planting a flag in the territory of your day and declaring this day belongs to the Lord. My steps belong to the Lord. My words belong to the Lord. My health belongs to the Lord. My business, my family, my finances, my future, they are under the covering of the most high God. And no weapon formed against any of these shall prosper. Let me teach you one more thing before we go into this prayer. In Genesis 1:5, after the first act of creation, the Bible records, "And the evening and the morning were the first day." Now, this is remarkable. God structures a day with the evening coming before the morning. In the Hebrew understanding, a new day begins at sunset. Which means by the time morning arrives, a day is already in progress. And yet morning is when the light appears. Morning is when things become visible. Morning is when what was hidden in the darkness is suddenly exposed. This is prophetically significant. Your morning prayer is what turns the light on in your day. Whatever the enemy planted in the darkness of your previous night, your morning prayer is what reveals it, uproots it, and destroys it before it takes root in your life. Your morning prayer is not catching up with the enemy. Your morning prayer is exposing the enemy's work and dismantling it by the power of the Holy Ghost. I declare to you today you will not walk into any ambush that was set for you this morning. Every trap that was laid while you slept, let the light of God's word expose it and the fire of the Holy Ghost consume it in the name of Jesus. Now, let us enter this place of prayer and I need you to pray with me. I need you to open your mouth. If you are in your room, pray. If you are in traffic, pray. If you are at your workplace listening to this, pray quietly in your spirit, but pray because this moment is a gate and what you send through this gate will determine what enters your day. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, we come before your throne of grace, not the throne of judgment, the throne of grace. Hebrews 4:16 says, "Let us therefore come boldly onto the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need." We come boldly, not timidly, not ashamed. Not with a sense of unworthiness that paralyzes us. We come with boldness because the blood of Jesus has made us worthy. The blood of Jesus has torn the veil. The blood of Jesus has opened the door into the holiest place and we enter now, we enter now with confidence, with reverence, and with expectation. Lord God, we sanctify this morning. We consecrate this day to you. We declare that this day is not ordinary. This day is a gift from you and we receive it as such. We declare that every hour of this day is loaded with divine opportunities, with supernatural encounters, with kingdom connections, with open doors that no man can shut, and with the tangible presence of the Holy Spirit going ahead of us, walking beside us, and covering our rear guard. Isaiah 52:12 says, "For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight, for the Lord will go before you and the God of Israel will be your reward. I receive this I receive this over my life. The Lord goes before me today. The God of Israel covers my back today. I am not unprotected. I am not exposed. I am not vulnerable. I am covered by a covenant that was sealed with the most precious substance in the universe, the blood of Jesus Christ, the lamb of God. Now, I want to go into warfare. I want to go into warfare because this morning is dangerous. Dangerous not because we are afraid. Dangerous because we are armed. Dangerous because we know that the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but they are mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. Dangerous because we know that the name of Jesus is above every other name. Dangerous because we know that at his name every knee shall bow. Things in heaven, things on earth, and things under the earth. We are dangerous this morning because we are praying from a position of victory and not from a position of defeat. Jesus already won. The cross already happened. The resurrection already occurred. Death is already defeated. Hell is already spoiled. The principalities and powers have already been made a public spectacle. We are not praying to achieve victory. We are praying from victory. We are praying to manifest in time and space what has already been accomplished in eternity. Let every demon that is listening to this prayer tremble. Let every principality that has been assigned to interrupt this day receive confusion and scattering right now in the name of Jesus. Let the fire of God descend on every assignment of darkness that was activated while we slept. Let it burn. Let it burn. Let it burn to ashes in the name of Jesus. I speak to the spirit of delay that has been shadowing some lives connected to this prayer. I speak to it right now. You spirit of delay, your legal right has been canceled by the blood of Jesus. Every agreement that gave you permission to operate, whether entered into consciously or unconsciously, whether inherited through bloodline or contracted through personal decisions, every one of those agreements is now annulled. It is voided. It is struck of the record of heaven in the name of Jesus. And I declare that what has been delayed shall now be released. What has been held back shall now break through. What has been stopped shall now flow freely like a river that has broken through every dam. In the name of Jesus. I want to speak to someone. You have been praying and it feels like your prayers are hitting the ceiling. It feels like heaven is brass and the earth is iron. You have been faithful. You have not given up. But there has been a heaviness, a thickness in the atmosphere around your life and you cannot explain it. The Lord says to you this morning, it is not because your prayer is weak. It is not because you are lacking in faith. There is a gate that has been shut by an ancient agreement and today, right now, in this service, that gate is being broken off its hinges by the power of the Holy Ghost. Receive it. Receive it. Your season of answered prayer is beginning today. Father, in the name of Jesus, we speak to every brass heaven that has been erected over any life represented in this prayer. We speak to it with the authority of the King of kings and we command it fall. Be removed. Be dissolved. Be shattered into a thousand fragments. In the name of Jesus, let the heavens open. Let the heavens open. Let the windows of heaven be flung wide open over every sincere heart that is crying out to you this morning. Let there be a supernatural flow of answers, of breakthroughs, of confirmations, of divine visitations beginning today in the name of Jesus. In Deuteronomy 28:12, the Bible says the Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure to the heaven to give the rain of thy land in his season and to bless all the work of thine hand. I declare this promise is active over every life in this prayer today. The Lord shall open unto you his good treasure. This is not a maybe. This is not a possibility. This is a covenant promise from the mouth of the unchanging God. And because he's not a man that he should lie, and because he's not the son of man that he should repent, every word that he has spoken shall come to pass. Now, I want to deal with the foundations because some people are building, they are working hard, they are praying, they are believing, but the foundation of certain areas of their life has been compromised. And a compromised foundation will limit the height of every structure built upon it. In Psalm 11:3, the question is raised, "If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?" And the answer is found in Psalm 87:1, "His foundation is in the holy mountains." God is a restorer of foundations. God is in the business of going back to the root, dealing with what is broken at the root, and then allowing everything that grows from that root to flourish supernaturally. Let us pray about foundations. Father, I come before you on behalf of every person whose foundation has been tampered with, every person whose bloodline carries spiritual pollutants, ancestral covenants, idol worship, bloodshed, sexual immorality committed by fathers and grandfathers and great-grandfathers that open doors to generational curses, I plead the blood of Jesus over every bloodline represented in this prayer. I plead the blood over the legal grounds that these ancient sins have created. I declare Galatians 3:13 over every curse that is operating. Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. For it is written, "Cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree." Jesus became a curse so that you and I could walk in blessing. Jesus took upon himself every curse, the curse of poverty, the curse of sickness, the curse of untimely death, the curse of barrenness, the curse of failure at the edge of success. Every curse was placed upon his body on that cross. And what he bore, you do not need to carry. I decree the termination of every generational curse operating in any bloodline that is connected to this prayer this morning. I decree termination, I decree cancellation, I decree severance every chain that has been passed from father to son, from mother to daughter, from generation to generation. Let the blood of Jesus Christ sever it right now. Let it be cut off. Let it be destroyed at the root. And let a new thing begin. Let a new chapter be written. Let the next generation of every family represented here experience the goodness of God in a way that their parents never knew. In the name of Jesus. I feel the fire of God right now. I feel the fire of God. I want to speak about witchcraft. I know that some people are uncomfortable with this word, but you must understand Galatians 5:20 list witchcraft as a work of the flesh. 1 Samuel 15:23 says for rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft. Witchcraft is real. Witchcraft is active. Witchcraft is one of the primary weapons that the enemy uses against the advancement of God's people. And witchcraft operates not just through herbalist and covens, it operates through manipulation, through intimidation, through control, through spoken curses, through dedicated objects, through food that has been contaminated spiritually, through evil eyes, through the jealousy of people who have covenanted themselves to darkness for the purpose of limiting your progress. But hear me, witchcraft has no jurisdiction over a blood washed, Holy Ghost filled, word grounded, prayer saturated child of the living God. No jurisdiction. 1 John 4:4 says greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. The greater one lives inside you. The greater one is not afraid of covens. The greater one is not intimidated by any herbalist, any necromancer, any diviner, any sorcerer. The greater one sits in the heavens and laughs at every plot that is hatched against his children. Let us pray about witchcraft. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come against every witchcraft operation assigned to any life in this service. Every monitoring spirit that has been dispatched to track movements, to gather information, to report to dark councils, I command every one of them be exposed, be revealed, be blinded, be paralyzed. Your assignment is terminated this morning by the fire of the Holy Ghost. You shall not succeed. Your report shall not be received. Your coordinates are confused. Your instruments of monitoring are destroyed by the blood of Jesus. Every evil altar that has been erected and dedicated against any life connected to this prayer, I speak to that altar right now. Let the fire of God fall on that altar. Let it consume that altar. Let it turn that altar to rubble. Let every sacrifice that has been placed on that altar for the purpose of harming God's children be rejected, be returned, be neutralized by the blood of Jesus. Every covenant with darkness that has been entered into on behalf of any person in this service by their enemies, by jealous relatives, by wicked neighbors, by business partners who have chosen the path of darkness, I declare every such covenant null and void in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Now, I speak a hedge of fire around every person in this service. Job 1:10, the devil himself acknowledged that God had placed a hedge around Job. I activate the hedge of God's protection over every life here. Above the hedge is set, below the hedge is set, in front the hedge is set, behind the hedge is set. To the left the hedge is set, to the right the hedge is set. You are surrounded not by the enemy's weapons, but by the fire of the living God. And every arrow that is aimed at you today shall not find its mark. The enemy shall look for you and find that you are hidden under the shadow of the Almighty. Psalm 91:1, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty." I need to pray about health right now. I feel the healing anointing. The Lord is healing people even as this prayer is going forth. Someone has been battling a diagnosis. A medical report was placed in your hand and when you read it, fear came in like a flood. The doctor used words you had never heard before. And since that day a shadow has been following you. but I declare to you this morning, Isaiah 53:5 says, by his stripes we were healed. Not we will be healed, we were healed, past tense, done, finished, settled in eternity. The body of Jesus took every disease, every infirmity, every sickness, every pain in that scourging, in those stripes, and what the body of Jesus absorbed in that terrible moment has been paid for in full. I speak to every sickness in every body represented in this prayer. I speak to cancer, you are not authorized, come out. In the name of Jesus, come out. Every cancerous cell, I command it die. Receive the death of Jesus. Every tumor, I speak to you, dissolve. Let the spirit of the living God move through every affected tissue, every affected organ, every affected system of the body, and let supernatural restoration occur right now, in the name of Jesus. Arteries that are blocked, let them be cleared. Bones that are broken, let them be knit together supernaturally. Nerves that have been damaged, let the healing virtue of the son of God move through them right now. Organs that are failing, receive strength, receive new life. Receive divine reinforcement in the name of Jesus. I speak to blood disorders this morning. I speak to every condition of the blood, sickle cell, leukemia, anemia, every blood-related condition, I command a creative miracle. Let new blood cells be created. Let the blood be sanctified by the blood of Jesus. Let whatever is wrong in the blood be corrected by the spirit of God who knows the blueprint of the human body because he designed it. In the name of Jesus. Mental health, I need to address mental health because the enemy is waging a vicious campaign against the minds of God's people. Second Timothy 1:7, "For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." A sound mind is the inheritance of every child of God, not a tormented mind, not a confused mind, not an anxious mind, not a mind that replaced trauma endlessly. A sound mind, a mind that is clear, a mind that is at peace, a mind that can think, can reason, can believe, can receive. I rebuke every spirit of mental torment in this service. I rebuke depression, I rebuke anxiety, I rebuke obsessive thought patterns that have been planted by the enemy. I rebuke paranoia, I rebuke every form of mental oppression in the name of Jesus. Spirit of torment, leave. You have no legal right to the mind of a blood washed believer. The mind of Christ belongs to us. First Corinthians 2:16 says, "But we have the mind of Christ." We don't just have our own minds, we have the mind of Christ available to us through the Holy Spirit. And I activate that mind over every tormented mind in this service right now. Let the peace of God that passes all understanding guard your heart and mind through Christ Jesus. Philippians 4:7, let it guard you, let it be a sentry, let it stand at the entrance of your thought life and refuse entry to every thought that does not align with the truth of God's word. Let me shift now. I want to pray about destiny because the greatest thing that the enemy targets is not your money, not your health, not your relationships. The greatest thing that the enemy targets is your destiny because your destiny fulfilled will produce impact that will outlast your lifetime. Your destiny fulfilled will bless nations. Your destiny fulfilled will cause generations yet unborn to rise up and call you blessed. And this is precisely why the enemy is so determined to abort your destiny, to derail it, to delay it, to degrade it, to make you settle for a diminished version of the great plan that God has for your life. In Jeremiah 29:11, God says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected end, an expected end." God has an expected end for your life. He has already seen your conclusion. He has already seen the full expression of your purpose, and what he sees is good. What he sees is glorious. What he sees is far beyond what you have been able to imagine on your best day. Now, I decree over destiny, every plan of God for your life that the enemy has tried to abort, I declare divine resuscitation over it right now. Every gift that was buried because of trauma, because of disappointment, because of the words of people who said you would never amount to anything, I speak to that buried gift, come up, come alive. Come out of the grave. Your time of concealment is over. Your time of emergence has come. God did not give you gifts to bury them. He gave you gifts to deploy them for his glory and for the blessing of mankind. I speak to divine helpers. Every divine helper that has been assigned to your life by God, every person through whom God has planned to bless you, to open doors for you, to connect you with resources that will advance your purpose, I release them. I declare that the supernatural connections of God will be activated in your life beginning today. The right people will find you. The right opportunities will come to you. The right doors will open for you. Not because of who you know, not because of your background, but because the God who knows all people and controls all circumstances has arranged divine appointments for you and you will not miss any of them. In Proverbs 18:16, "A man's gift maketh room for him and bringeth him before great men." Your gift will make room for you. Your gift will bring you before the right people. Your gift will open doors that no human networking could ever open. Trust the gift. Develop the gift. Deploy the gift and watch God use the gift to transform your world. Now, I want to deal with financial chains. Because I know that in this service there are people who are working hard, genuinely working hard, but there seems to be a leak. There seems to be a spiritual leak in the financial container of their life. Money comes in and money goes out. Increase comes and then something happens and the increase disappears. Promotions come, but the expected prosperity doesn't follow. Opportunities arise, but the expected returns don't materialize. This is not natural. This is a spiritual assignment and it must be dealt with in the spirit. Haggai 1:6 describes the experience. "Ye have sown much and bring in little. Ye eat, but ye have not enough. Ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink. Ye clothe you, but there is none warm. And he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes, a bag with holes." This is a spiritual condition, not an economic one, and the remedy is not a salary increase. The remedy is addressing the altar. The remedy is identifying and destroying the spiritual mechanism that is creating the holes. In the name of Jesus, I address every spirit of financial leakage, every demonic mechanism that creates holes in the financial life, I command it be destroyed, be blocked, be sealed in the name of Jesus. Every devourer that has been operating against finances, I rebuke it by the authority of Malachi 3:11. The word of God says, "And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes." God himself takes responsibility for rebuking the devourer. When you are in a place of covenant faithfulness, I rebuke the devourer, I rebuke the spirit of poverty, I rebuke the spirit that converts income to expenses before there is any tangible kingdom result, I rebuke it right now in the name of Jesus. I declare abundance, I declare supernatural multiplication, I declare that the financial grace of God shall begin to manifest in your life in ways that you cannot explain by any natural formula. Money shall come to you from sources you did not work for, resources shall flow to you as kingdom inheritance, not just as wages. God shall establish you as a financial force in your generation, not for your own comfort but for the advancement of his kingdom. His church shall be funded, his missionary shall be supported. His gospel shall be propagated through the resources that flow through your hands, and as you become a channel of blessing, the blessing itself shall never dry up in your life. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant. God gives power to get wealth. This is not a religious cliche. This is a covenant mechanism. God supernaturally empowers covenant people to generate wealth for the purpose of establishing his covenant on the earth. And I declare that empowerment over every life in this service today. Receive the power, receive the grace, receive the supernatural ability, receive the divine wisdom that creates wealth. Receive it now in the name of Jesus. I want to pray about marriage and relationships because I know in this service there are people who are standing on the promise of God for a spouse. There are people whose marriages are under severe attack. There are people who entered marriage and discovered that they married into covenants they knew nothing about. There are people whose homes have become battlegrounds instead of sanctuaries. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak peace over every home represented in this service. Let the peace of God that passes all understanding, let it enter every home. Let it walk through every room. Let it sit at every table. Let it rest on every bed. Let it fill the atmosphere of every home so that when family members walk in through the door, they breathe in the presence of God before they even say a word. For marriages under attack, I speak the blood of Jesus. The covenant of marriage was established by God and what God joins together, no man and no demon has the right to put asunder. I rebuke every spirit of divorce. I rebuke every spirit of adultery and fornication. I rebuke every strange woman and every strange man that the enemy has planted in the path of covenant and spouses. In the name of Jesus, be removed, be exposed. Let the light of God shine on every dark strategy being deployed against marriages in this service. Let it be exposed. Let it be dismantled. Let it fail. In the name of Jesus. I speak restoration. Where there has been hurt, let healing come. Where there has been betrayal, let trust be rebuilt by the grace of God. Where there has been silence and distance, let communication be restored. Where there has been coldness, let the fire of God warm the hearts of spouses toward each other. Let love be renewed. Let commitment be deepened. Let the beauty of covenant be rediscovered. And let every marriage in this service become a testimony of God's power to restore and transform. In the name of Jesus. For those believing God for a spouse, I declare that your divine appointment shall not be missed. The person God has prepared for you is being prepared. The timing of God is perfect. And his timing shall not be frustrated by the manipulations of the enemy. I declare that you shall not settle for less than God's best. You shall not enter a covenant that was not ordained by heaven. You shall not be deceived by the counterfeit when the authentic is on its way. Hold your peace. Maintain your purity. Trust the wisdom of God. And at the appointed time, the time that God has already set, your help shall arrive. Not late, not a day after, but at the exact moment when the fullness of God's plan is ready to be unveiled. Now, I want to speak prophetically. There is someone in this service who has been at a crossroads. You are facing a major decision and you are afraid of making the wrong choice. The fear of failure, the fear of making a mistake has paralyzed you. You have been standing at this intersection for months, maybe years, unable to move left or unable to move right. And the Lord says to you this morning, I am with you. I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will guide you with my eye. Psalm 32:8, the Lord's eye is on you. His counsel is available to you. His wisdom is being released to you even now. Move. Move in the direction that the peace of God is leading you. Where there is deep inexplicable peace, that is the hand of God. Follow it. Trust it. And watch God confirm every step that you take in obedience to his leadership. There is another person. You have been fighting a battle of identity. You have been questioning who you are, whether you belong, whether you are loved, whether you are valued. The enemy has been speaking lies over you. And the tragedy is that some of those lies came through the mouths of people who should have spoken life. Parents, teachers, leaders. And those words formed a prison around your perception of yourself. But the Lord says to you today, you are not what they said. You are what I say. And what I say is this, you are fearfully and wonderfully made. Psalm 139:14, you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation. 1 Peter 2:9. You are the apple of God's eye. Zechariah 2:8. You are loved with an everlasting love. Jeremiah 31:3. Every lie that was spoken over your identity, I command it to fall right now. Let it fall. Let it be dismantled. And let the truth of God's word about who you are rise in your spirit like the sun rising in the morning. Undeniable, brilliant, warming, life-giving. Let me deal with time because some people have lost time, they have wasted years, they have spent portions of their life in seasons that now feel like a void, and there is a grief associated with that lost time. A regret, a sense that it is too late, that the best years have gone. But I want you to know what Joel 2 verses 25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you." God is a time restorer. God can compress into 1 year what should have taken 10 years. God can accelerate you to a position that would naturally require decades to reach. God can cause one encounter, one meeting, one divine appointment to do more for your life than years of your own striving. This is the God we serve. This is the God who is activating his restoration agenda over your life right now. I decree time restoration over you. Every year that the enemy stole, God is returning it with interest. Every season that was wasted in the wrong place, with the wrong people, pursuing the wrong things, God is redeeming even that. He's turning those years of pain into preparation. He's turning those seasons of confusion into the curriculum that qualifies you for the next level. Nothing is wasted in the economy of God, nothing. He's a master at making all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose. Romans 8 verses 28. Father, in the name of Jesus, I bring every person connected to this service before your throne of grace right now. I ask for the supernatural acceleration of divine purpose in their lives. I ask for the releasing of divine favor that will cause them to experience results that their effort alone cannot explain. Let favor go before them today like a pillar of cloud. Let favor surround them on every side. Let people look at them and see the unmistakable evidence of God's hand on their lives. Let doors open that they didn't knock on. Let opportunities find them. Let resources seek them out. Let the right people be supernaturally attracted to them. Let there be a grace upon their lives that is visible, tangible, and impossible to deny. I speak to angels. I speak to the ministering spirits that have been dispatched from heaven to serve those who are heirs of salvation. In Hebrews 1:14, the word says, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?" Angels have been assigned. Specific angels have been assigned to every person in this service, and I release them now. I release them to go ahead of you into this day, into every meeting, into every opportunity, into every place where decisions are being made that will affect your life. Let angels go. Let them prepare the atmosphere. Let them move the hearts of kings and leaders in your favor. Let them block every ambush. Let them dismantle every trap. Let them clear every path. Let them make the crooked places straight and the rough places smooth. Isaiah 45:2, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron." God himself promises to go before you. To break gates of brass, to cut bars of iron. Every locked gate in your life, let it be broken. Every bar of iron that has been holding a door of opportunity closed against you, let it be caught. Let it fall. Let the door swing open and let you walk through it with confidence, with grace, with authority, and with the full backing of heaven. Now, let us do a final push. Let us end this morning prayer with a declaration that will set the tone for the entire day because what you declare at the beginning is what you experience throughout. Let your mouth agree with the word of God. Let your voice decree what heaven has already decided over your life. I declare I'm not alone today. The Lord my God is with me wherever I go. Joshua 1:9. I declare no weapon that is formed against me today shall prosper. Isaiah 54:17. I declare I am walking in divine favor today. The Lord's face is shining upon me and he's gracious to me. Numbers 6:25. I declare my steps are ordered by the Lord today. Psalm 37:23. I will not make wrong decisions. I will not miss divine appointments. I will not waste this day. I declare the spirit of the Lord is upon me. Luke 4:18. I walk in spiritual power and authority today. I am not powerless. I am not helpless. I am anointed. I declare the angel of the Lord encamps around me today and delivers me from every evil. Psalm 34:7. I declare the grace of God is sufficient for every challenge that this day presents. 2 Corinthians 12:9. I declare I am more than a conqueror through him that loved me. Romans 8:37. Not just a conqueror, more than a conqueror. Overwhelmingly victorious through the one who loved me and gave himself for me. I declare this is the day that the Lord has made. Psalm 118:24. I will rejoice and be glad in it. Not in circumstances, not in the absence of challenges, but in the absolute unchanging covenant-keeping faithfulness of the God I serve. Father, seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. Let every word that has been declared this morning be backed by the authority of heaven. Let every decree find its fulfillment. Let every intercession be answered. Let every petition be granted. Let every person who prayed this prayer this morning leave this place covered, covered from the crown of their head to the soles of their feet with the presence, the power, and the protection of the Holy Spirit. Let this day be different. Let this day mark a before and after in the lives of everyone in this service. Let those who were bound wake up free. Let those who were confused wake up with clarity. Let those who were afraid wake up with boldness. Let those who were in lack wake up with a supernatural supply beginning to flow. Let those who were sick wake up with strength they cannot explain. Let those who were grieving wake up with joy unspeakable and full of glory. Because this is the power of dangerous morning prayer. This is what happens when the sons and daughters of God rise early before the distractions, before the noise. Before the world gets access to their minds and their hearts and they bring everything to the feet of Jesus, this is what happens. Heaven responds, the earth shifts, atmospheres change, destinies are rerouted, and the day that looked ordinary becomes a day that God saturates with his extraordinary. Go into your day, go covered, go armed, go in the authority of the name of Jesus. Go with the full armor of God, the helmet of salvation covering your mind, the breastplate of righteousness protecting your heart, the belt of truth securing every area of your life, the shoes of the gospel of peace carrying you into divine appointments, the shield of faith extinguishing every flaming arrow of the enemy, and the sword of the spirit, the word of God in your mouth. Go armed, go dangerous, go in the confidence that the battle has already been won, and the victory has already been secured. The Lord bless you, the Lord keep you, the Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you, the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. This is your day, receive it in the name of Jesus. Amen.
